node.statement: Binary first-index splitting lemma: there is a universal accuracy threshold such that, whenever R_0,R_1,T are uniformly bounded approximate projections, R=R_0+R_1 is an approximate projection, and R_0,R_1 are approximately orthogonal, the canonical assembly map A:S_{R_0,T} direct-sum S_{R_1,T}->S_{R,T}, A(X_0,X_1)=Co_{R,T}(X_0+X_1), is a bounded linear bijection.
